notes.title: Urizen Frosty Plus Boxed Edition Available Now
notes.content:
https://www.etsy.com/listing/1033881635/video-game-urizen-shadows-of-the-cold?ref=shop_home_active_3

Red Moon Store on Etsy is offering Urizen Shadows of the Cold Frosty Plus Edition in a boxed format that comes with complete manual, stickers, latest version of the game on USB, a demo soundtrack, and soundtrack on cds.  For PC only....click link above.

notes.title: Critical Upgrade for Save and Load Feature
notes.content:
So I had my buddy at the coding department help me upgrade the much needed, save and load feature which only reflected the loaded file temporarily with the end result resulting in the save being lost, which defeated the save feature in the first place.  A configuration file was made to store such...with this I now know this project is in good standing... 
Thank You
John Metalman
Red Moon Studio

notes.title: Urizen Shadows of the Cold Frosty PLUS Edition will be out in a few minutes!!!
notes.content:
The release of Urizen Shadows of the Cold Deluxe Frosty PLUS Edition will be out in 10 min.  This is a re-release upgraded and updated game that features so much more, including speed upgrades and glitch fixes.  I look forward to your comments, but keep them cool, please.  This re-release includes new warriors like Whiskers, Pinkbird, and Scoobers.  I really hope you guys find this a great way to get away from the epidemic...

THANK YOU
Joihn MetalMan @ Red Moon Studio
